description: Experience the ultimate in versatility with Rothco’s Convertible Canvas Duffle Backpack. Perfect for travel, work, or a quick getaway, the weekender bag offers ample storage for travel accessories, clothing, outdoor gear, and everyday carry essentials. The military travel bag is designed to easily switch between a duffle bag and backpack for flexible carrying options, ensuring you are ready for any adventure. High-Capacity Storage Space: The 30L travel bag features a top-load main compartment with dual zippers and side cinch straps for quick, convenient packing. The duffle backpack comes equipped with a large front pocket and hidden side pockets for a laptop, tablet, and other essentials. The convertible backpack measures 19 inch x 11 inch. Carry Options: These canvas duffle bags feature hideaway backpack straps that are fully adjustable and deploy quickly for on-the-go conversion. The mesh padding provides additional comfort and cooling. The camping backpack features grab handles at the top and side for easy carry. Top Grade Canvas: Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul, allowing the travel backpack to withstand outdoor adventures or frequent trips. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs. Adventure Ready: Whether you’re out traveling or camping in the woods, the convertible duffle bag ensures your possessions are safe and secure. The large military backpack is great for campers, hikers, travelers, commuters, everyday use, and more.
